LISP is in a really bad state out here at SAIL.  I desperately
want a working CASEQ, for example.  NEWIO doesn't work, and
we cannot really bring up a new OLDIO either.  We also need
a new compiler to win with LSUBR CONS, etc.  The NEWIO has the
bug that reading files with more than one page seems to read
the page break as the symbol with the null print name.  Please
give some thought to bringing up some new SAIL version soon?
